description: Read popups. No id: the popups (status, draft vs published, 7-day views and conversion), site-wide rules, site look and plan limit. id: one popup (config, body, css, fill-ins, warnings). view templates: the template catalog. view stats + id: views, closes, conversions by day (range 7d/30d/90d; available:false = no data store yet). preview + id: a draft link and whether it would show.

preview.description: With id: draft preview url + trace.

previewAs.description: What-if for preview: {path, device: desktop|tablet|mobile, visitor: new|returning, now: ISO time, state: {closedDaysAgo, convertedDaysAgo, views, viewsThisVisit}}.
